Question: Halfway through a \(100\)-shot archery tournament, Chelsea leads by \(50\) points. For each shot a bullseye scores \(10\) points, with other possible scores being \(8,\) \(4,\) \(2,\) and \(0\) points. Chelsea always scores at least \(4\) points on each shot. If Chelsea’s next \(n\) shots are bullseyes she will be guaranteed victory. What is the minimum value for \(n?\)
